en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own situation and get the same visa, health-cover and budget comparison for your retirement move
en.runTitle: Ohio retiree on USD 3,250 a month: a Chiang Mai move in October 2027

fields.label: Monthly income sources, gross or net
fields.value: USD 2,350 Social Security plus USD 900 pension

fields.label: Health conditions and medicines
fields.placeholder: e.g. blood-pressure tablets, one knee replacement

fields.label: Current health coverage
fields.placeholder: e.g. Medicare Part A and B plus a supplement plan

en.template: Help me plan a retirement move to {city} from {home} in {when}. I am {age}, {marital}, with {income}, {savings}, {conditions} and {coverage}. Compare the visa routes I could qualify for, list the financial and paperwork tests for each, build a monthly budget with rent examples and health cover, and give me a list of tax and insurance questions to take to a professional.

phases.title: Read the official visa, health-cover, Medicare, tax and rental pages
phases.note: Thai embassy and immigration pages, insurer and hospital prices, Medicare.gov, the US–Thailand tax treaty and condo listings
phases.judgment: When it found a newer retirement-visa order in Thailand’s Royal Gazette but could not read or translate it reliably, it did not guess. The visa thresholds rest on dated official guidance pages, and the gap is flagged for the reader.

phases.title: Write the guide and the full source list
phases.note: Visa comparison, health cover, Medicare decision, tax questions, rent examples and a monthly budget in baht and dollars

phases.title: Check every money figure and claim a second time, then test desktop and phone layouts
phases.judgment: A second pass recomputed every budget row (all 15 matched at 35 baht to the dollar) and caught one factual slip: on arrival in October 2027 she will be 66 or 67, not 67 or 68. The guide and source list were corrected.

workers: Assigned the tax and housing side: questions to take to a US–Thailand tax adviser, and dated condo rent examples in Nimman, Santitham and Hang Dong
Assigned the health side: insurance cost for a new 66-year-old applicant, private-hospital price examples in Chiang Mai, and the Medicare Part B decision
